epitran.source: PyPI installation in disposable Linux execution sandbox

english_flite.build: ./configure && make; testsuite/make lex_lookup; lex_lookup placed on PATH
english_flite.note: Debian flite packages alone did not provide lex_lookup, so the official Epitran source-build instructions were followed.

chinese_route.cantonese: source Study-1 transcription -> Epitran yue-Latn, tones enabled
chinese_route.mandarin: source Study-1 transcription -> Epitran cmn-Latn, tones enabled
chinese_route.note: This avoids character-level CC-Canto/CC-CEDict lookup for the Phase-0 rows that already contain source romanization.

caution: This lock reproduces engineering feasibility only. Native/source-language pronunciation validation remains mandatory before confirmatory phonology.
